source_refs.note: ii. Unique Solvent Abilities: a main subheading of 33.1 Properties and Quality of Water, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 247-247.

blocks.text: Polarity also makes water a good solvent for a wide range of ionic substances, such as metallic ions, nitrates (NO₃⁻) and phosphates (PO₄³⁻), by surrounding the ions. Furthermore, the ability of water to dissolve polar organic compounds means that many pesticides and herbicides easily enter the water cycle, where they can persist and undergo bioaccumulation.
